method_note: FAST MODE stage 1. Candidates: Kenya, Tanzania (incl. Zanzibar), South Africa (Cape Town, Winelands), Botswana, Namibia, Rwanda, Seychelles, Mauritius, Morocco, Egypt. Smartraveller levels, official marriage pages, met services or labelled tourism boards, and live weddedwonderland.com pages only. Reused facts keep original dates. Never link /destinations/africa (hidden). Coordinator update: final shortlist adds Victoria Falls (Zambia, Zimbabwe), drops Namibia and Rwanda (not saved). Smartraveller overall lines for the 10 original candidates read from page markdown (high); Zambia, Zimbabwe and all weather and region lines from Firecrawl LLM extraction (medium). Namibia 'Exercise normal safety precautions' and Rwanda 'Exercise normal safety precautions' (Do not travel: Rubavu district) noted here only, if reinstated.

facts.claim: You cannot register an overseas marriage in Australia, but in most cases it is legally recognised if it was valid under the law of the country where it happened and would have been valid under Australian law had it occurred in Australia. A foreign marriage certificate is usually accepted as proof of the marriage, but may not be usable as proof of a name change; check with your state or territory BDM registry.
facts.quote: You cannot register an overseas marriage in Australia, but in most cases it is legally recognised if it was valid under the law of the country where it happened and would have been valid under Australian law had it occurred in Australia. A foreign marriage certificate is usually accepted as proof of the marriage, but may not be usable as proof of a name change; check with your state or territory BDM registry.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice for Kenya: Exercise a high degree of caution. Higher levels apply in some areas.
facts.quote: Overall: Exercise a high degree of caution
facts.use_note: Overall line read from the page markdown. Updated 04 November 2026, still current 26 November 2026.

facts.claim: Do not travel to the Somalia border regions, including all of Mandera and Garissa counties and eastern Wajir county.
facts.quote: Do not travel to border regions with Somalia due to the high risk of terrorist attack and kidnapping, including all of Mandera and Garissa counties and the part of Wajir county extending from the town of Wajir eastwards to the border with Somalia.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction; check verbatim before publishing. Latest update also notes Ebola health screening on arrival, mandatory ETA and mandatory inbound travel health insurance via the ETA.

facts.claim: Kenya normally has two rainy seasons, March to June and October to November; flash flooding and mudslides are common.
facts.quote: Kenya normally has two rainy seasons: from March to June and October to November. ... Flash flooding and mudslides are common.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction of the Extreme weather section; check verbatim. No KMD season page read (see needs).

facts.quote: Overall: Exercise a high degree of caution

facts.claim: Do not travel to within 30km of the Mozambique border in the Mtwara region.

facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction; check verbatim.

facts.claim: Rainy season March to May and November to December; monsoons in coastal and island areas July to October; cyclones in coastal areas are common.
facts.quote: During the rainy season (March to May and November to December), floods can block roads. Monsoons occur in coastal and island areas from July to October. Cyclones in coastal areas are also common.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice for South Africa: Exercise a high degree of caution. Crime and violence are serious issues across South Africa; an online traveller declaration is required to enter or leave.
facts.quote: Overall: Exercise a high degree of caution
facts.use_note: Overall line read from page markdown. Latest update text (crime, protests, traveller declaration) from LLM extraction, medium.

facts.claim: The rainy season is from November to March and can bring heavy rainfall and thunderstorms; flash floods can occur across the country.
facts.quote: The rainy season is from November to March and can result in heavy rainfall and thunderstorms.
facts.use_note: LLM extraction, check verbatim. This is a national line: the Western Cape (Cape Town, Winelands) has winter rainfall, so do not apply 'November to March' to Cape Town. See C-01 and N-ZA-season (SAWS).

facts.claim: Foreigners can marry in South Africa under South African law. Couples present original valid passports to the Marriage Officer on the day; complete form BI-130; book an appointment (Home Affairs regional office or a Minister of Religion). Without an antenuptial contract the marriage is registered in community of property. An abridged certificate (R10.00) is issued on the day; an unabridged certificate (R45.00) takes six to eight weeks and usually needs legalisation for use abroad.
facts.quote: The couple need to submit their original valid passports to the Marriage Officer on the day of the wedding.  No other documents or any certified translations will be necessary.  In all cases, whether being married by a Home Affairs official or a Minister of Religion, the couple will need to make an appointment for the ceremony. ... If such contract is not produced to the marriage officer, the marriage will be registered as "In community of Property". ... Such certificate takes six to eight weeks to be issued
facts.publisher: South African Consulate General, New York (DIRCO)
facts.use_note: Official (DIRCO consulate), not dha.gov.za itself; page undated and the fees look old. Search snippets also cite a July 2026 IOL report that Home Affairs wants marriages involving a foreign national concluded at Home Affairs (news, not official; not cited). Write: 'confirm with the Department of Home Affairs'. Fees in ZAR, do not convert. Smartraveller lists CNI where asked.

facts.claim: Kenya's State Law Office (Registrar of Marriages) says a special licence applies to civil, Christian and Hindu marriages where one or both parties are foreign nationals, or the marriage is outside a gazetted location (for example a garden or hotel wedding). Both applicants must be resident in Kenya for at least seven days before applying; application is online via eCitizen, followed by an interview with original documents. A civil marriage by special licence is conducted within 14 days of approval. Fee Kshs 7,200 at a licensed place of worship or Kshs 14,200 outside one.
facts.quote: A special license applies to Civil, Christian and Hindu marriages where: One or both parties are foreign nationals; The marriage is taking place outside a gazetted location for example a garden wedding, hotel among others. ... Both applicants must be resident in Kenya for a period of at least seven (7) days preceding the application. ... A Civil marriage by Special License is conducted within Fourteen (14) days from the date of approval;
facts.publisher: Office of the Attorney General and Department of Justice (State Law Office), Kenya
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction of the page body; check verbatim. Fees in KES, government fees not package prices; do not convert. Notice route (21 days) is for Kenyan nationals or registered refugees residing in Kenya, per https://statelaw.go.ke/services-to-the-public/getting-married-in-kenya/registration-of-marriage-by-notice/. Confirm current process with the Registrar of Marriages.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice for Seychelles: Exercise normal safety precautions. Entry restrictions apply for travellers recently in the DRC (Ebola).
facts.quote: Overall: Exercise normal safety precautions
facts.use_note: Updated 28 October 2026.

facts.claim: Heavy rain and flooding can occur, especially during the monsoon season from November to March.
facts.quote: Heavy rain and flooding can occur, especially during the monsoon season from November to March.
facts.use_note: Firecrawl LLM extraction; check verbatim. No Seychelles Meteorological Authority page read (see needs).

facts.claim: Seychelles Immigration and Civil Status: any person in accordance with the Laws of Seychelles can get married; banns are published for eleven days before the marriage, or a marriage licence can be applied for (approval of the Chief Officer of Civil Status, fee SR500). Foreigner couples supply the registration form, birth certificates, divorce or death certificates if applicable, passport copies, all apostilled and authenticated.
facts.quote: Any person in accordance with the Laws of Seychelles can get married. Before the marriage can take place, the banns are published for eleven days prior to the date of marriage. ... All Document should be apostille and Authenticated ... in cases that the couple intends to get married before the full publication period, then a marriage licence should be applied, subject to the approval of the Chief Officer of Civil Status. A fee of SR500 is applicable
facts.use_note: Read from page markdown. SCR government fee; do not convert.

facts.claim: Standard Operating Procedure (1 April 2025) for civil marriages involving two foreigners: forms in hard copy by the parties or designated representatives; apostilled originals, by courier to the planner before arrival or in person on arrival; sworn translation if not in English or French; banns eleven days or licence SR500; official certificate issued within 24 hours subject to government fees; couple or planner must have the certificate apostilled.
facts.quote: Marriage banns must be published for eleven (11) days before the marriage date. ... The official marriage certificate will be issued within 24 hours, subject to the payment of the prescribed government marriage fees. It is the responsibility of the wedding parties or their designated representative/wedding planner to have the marriage certificate apostilled or authenticated as required.
facts.publisher: Department of Immigration and Civil Status, Seychelles (also tourism.gov.sc SOP PDF, 1 April 2025)
facts.use_note: Most current official procedure. Same text in https://tourism.gov.sc/wp-content/uploads/2025/04/SOP-wedding-April-2025.pdf. See C-02 on older licence fee.

facts.claim: Australian High Commission (Port Louis) page for Australians: a church wedding without a civil ceremony is not recognised as legal; there are no nationality requirements; couple must be in Seychelles at least 2 days before the civil ceremony; plan at least two months ahead.
facts.quote: A church wedding without a civil ceremony is not recognised as being legal and the parties must therefore contract a civil wedding prior to the religious ceremony. ... There are no nationality requirements that need to be fulfilled.
facts.use_note: Undated and older: its Special Licence 'SR100' and venue fees (SR350, SR500, SR700) are superseded by ics.gov.sc (SR500 licence). Use for civil-before-religious and no nationality requirement only.

facts.claim: Smartraveller overall advice for Botswana: Exercise normal safety precautions. No visa needed for tourists visiting up to 90 days; extra documents may be needed when travelling with children.
facts.quote: Overall: Exercise normal safety precautions

facts.claim: The wet season is usually November to March and can bring heavy rainfall and thunderstorms; flooding occurs on low ground around rivers.

facts.claim: Marriages are not performed or registered at the Australian Embassy in Morocco. Australians may be asked for a Certificate of No Impediment (CNI), issued by appointment at the Embassy for a fee. For Moroccan requirements contact the nearest Moroccan diplomatic mission.
facts.quote: Marriages are not performed or registered at the Australian Embassy in Morocco. If you're an Australian citizen who intends on getting married in Morocco, you might be asked to present a Certificate of No Impediment to Marriage ... For further information on the requirements to getting married in Morocco, you should contact your nearest Moroccan diplomatic mission, as we are unable to provide further information on Moroccan requirements.
facts.use_note: FACT-GAP-LEGAL: no Moroccan government page found on whether two foreign non-Muslims can marry legally. Write 'confirm with the Moroccan embassy in Canberra'; consider symbolic ceremony framing only if the business confirms.

facts.quote: Overall: Exercise a high degree of caution
facts.use_note: Updated 14 September 2026. Higher-level regions not extracted; check page (N item).

facts.claim: Sand and dust storms occur between March and May.
facts.quote: Sand and dust storms occur between March and May.
facts.use_note: LLM extraction; check verbatim.

facts.claim: Under Egyptian law, non-Egyptians must conduct a civil marriage at the Foreigners' Marriage Office at the Ministry of Justice; the non-Egyptian party presents a CNI from their embassy in Egypt, plus an embassy letter based on a Statutory Declaration. Smartraveller: check requirements via the Australian Embassy in Cairo or the Egyptian Embassy in Canberra.
facts.quote: According to Egyptian law, in order for non-Egyptians to undertake a legal marriage in Egypt, they need to conduct a civil marriage at the Foreigners' Marriage Office at the Ministry of Justice. The non-Egyptian party to the marriage is required to present a Certificate of No Impediment to Marriage (CNI) issued by their embassy in Egypt.
facts.use_note: Legal ceremony is at the Ministry of Justice in Cairo, so a Nile or Red Sea ceremony would be the celebration, not the legal act. Confirm with the Egyptian Embassy in Canberra.

facts.claim: Tanzania High Commission: foreigners intending to marry in Tanzania need a certificate of no impediment from their home country. With less than 21 days for a notice of intention to marry, apply to the Registrar of Marriages for a Special Marriage Licence, then set the date with the District Commissioner's office, church or mosque. Two witnesses required. For an International Marriage Certificate, register at the Registrar of Marriages (Arusha Office) on form RGM 111 (about TZS 22,000, plus TZS 7,000). Zanzibar marriage certificates must be certified by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Dar es Salaam.
facts.quote: If you are intending to get married in Tanzania, a certificate of no impediment from your home country is required. ... If you have less than 21 days required to put 'a notice of intention to marry', you need to make an application for 'Special Marriages Licence' from the Registrar of Marriages.
facts.publisher: Tanzania High Commission, New Delhi (official mission)
facts.use_note: LLM extraction; check verbatim. Mainland process. Zanzibar has its own civil registrar (ZCSRA); no ZCSRA or RITA page read: FACT-GAP-LEGAL for Zanzibar specifics. TZS government fees, do not convert.

facts.quote: Overall: Exercise normal safety precautions

facts.claim: Our Mauritius page: application must reach the Central Civil Status Office in Port Louis at least one month before the wedding; visit the Office with originals on arrival before the 24-hour publication and the ceremony; a Civil Status Officer celebrates the marriage, which can be in the Office, a hotel or other premises; no payment at the Office, a fee applies elsewhere.
facts.quote: Your application must reach the Central Civil Status Office in Port Louis at least one month before the wedding, with documents forwarded 6 to 8 weeks ahead. Once you land, you visit the Office together with your original documents before the 24-hour publication and the ceremony. A Civil Status Officer celebrates the marriage, and it can take place in the Office, a marriage hall, a hotel or any other private or non-private premises.
facts.use_note: Our own page, not an official source: legal steps must be confirmed with the Mauritius Civil Status Division (FACT-GAP-LEGAL, N item). LLM extraction; check verbatim.

facts.claim: Our Mauritius page: summer November to April is warm and humid; winter June to September relatively cool and dry; February and March the wettest months, October the driest.
facts.quote: Summer, from November to April, is warm and humid. Winter, from June to September, is relatively cool and dry, and October and May are transition months. ... February and March are the wettest months and October the driest.
facts.use_note: Wording matches Mauritius Meteorological Services style, but MMS page not read today; cite MMS once sourced (N item). Pair with Smartraveller cyclone line.

facts.claim: Our Seychelles page: open to Australians aged 18 and over; documents in English or French with an apostille; banns run eleven days, or a special licence is normally issued within two days; civil marriage first, religious alongside not instead; symbolic ceremony has no legal formalities.
facts.quote: Getting married in Seychelles is open to Australians aged 18 and over, and in most cases Australia recognises the marriage. ... The banns run for eleven days before the wedding, or a special marriage licence is normally issued within two days of applying.
facts.use_note: Link as internal page. 'Within two days' comes from the old Australian High Commission page; ics.gov.sc gives no timing (C item).

facts.claim: Our South Africa page: foreign nationals can marry in South Africa without establishing residency; no marriage licence is issued and a marriage officer solemnises the wedding; marriages are in community of property unless an ante-nuptial contract is signed; registered with the Department of Home Affairs; a celebrant who is not an authorised marriage officer cannot register a legal marriage.
facts.quote: Foreign nationals can marry in South Africa without establishing residency, provided they meet the applicable legal requirements. ... South Africa does not issue a marriage licence, and a marriage officer solemnises the wedding. ... Marriages are in the community of property unless an ante-nuptial contract is signed.
facts.use_note: Consistent with DIRCO (F-10). See C item on certificate fees.

facts.claim: Our African honeymoon page: safari at its best May to October; Botswana dry season May to October with Delta flood waters peaking June to August; South African reserves best May to September and Cape Town November to March; Victoria Falls water highest March to June, lower water September to December allows Devil's Pool on the Zambian side; 5 to 7 nights safari then 3 to 4 nights Zanzibar.
facts.quote: Safari is at its best from May to October, and the rainy months reward couples who want quieter camps. ... The dry season runs from May to October, and flood waters peak in the Delta from June to August. ... Reserves are at their best from May to September, and Cape Town shines from November to March. ... Water levels are highest from March to June, and from September to December the lower water allows swimming at Devil's Pool on the Zambian side.
facts.use_note: Final URL (old /expert-advice/african-honeymoons-private-safari-and-island-escapes-by-season redirects here). LLM extraction; mapping of each sentence to a country inferred from order, check on page. Also: 'The best months are June to September and December to February' (destination not confirmed). Page mentions a daily conservation levy, no amount. Own page, not official season source.

conflicts.detail: Smartraveller gives a national rainy season of November to March. Whether this fits Cape Town and the Winelands is not yet confirmed by an official source; do not apply the national line to Cape Town until SAWS is sourced (N-01). Flag only, not a confirmed conflict.
Licence fee to waive the 11-day banns: ics.gov.sc and the 2025 SOP say SR500; the undated Australian High Commission page says SR100 issued within two days. Use ics.gov.sc; do not quote the old fees.

DIRCO New York page: abridged certificate R10.00, unabridged R45.00. Our SA page: handwritten certificate free, first abridged certificate free. Our page says not to rely on historical fee schedules. Do not quote fees; say 'confirm with Home Affairs'.

Our page: special licence 'normally issued within two days'. Source of that is the old Australian High Commission page; ics.gov.sc and the 2025 SOP give no issue time. Avoid the 'two days' claim or attribute it.

Smartraveller: Botswana wet season November to March; South Africa national rainy season November to March. Our honeymoon page: Cape Town 'shines from November to March'. Not necessarily contradictory (Smartraveller line is national), but needs SAWS before stating Cape Town's best months as fact.

needs.need: SAWS (weathersa.co.za) Western Cape seasonal statement. Smartraveller's national 'November to March' rainy season may not fit Cape Town; no official Cape Town season line sourced yet.

FACT-GAP-LEGAL: official Civil Status Division (civilstatus.govmu.org) page for two non-citizens not reached; only secondary sources and the 1981 Civil Status Act on a third-party host. Confirm process with the Civil Status Division before citing our own page's steps.
FACT-GAP-LEGAL: Zanzibar Civil Status Registration Agency (zcsra.go.tz) process for foreigners not read; Zanzibar is outside the mainland Marriage Act per secondary sources.
